claims: C1 the section on protecting privileged information carries root authority
C2 this root authority applies to all rules under the heading

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule that carries the root level of instruction authority, the highest level, not overridable by system, developer or user instructions

concepts.name: rule_under_heading
concepts.gloss: the rule is located under the named heading in the document
concepts.inference: the node speaks of all rules under the heading, so a relation between a rule and a heading must exist

concepts.name: protect_privileged_information_heading
concepts.gloss: the document heading 'Do not reveal privileged information' with the protect_privileged_information anchor

ontology.gloss: R is a rule under the 'Do not reveal privileged information' heading and therefore carries root authority
